art_direction: 宽细线眼外侧下缘断开，双瞳向左，留白像偏斜胖逗号，眉尾舒展。
composition: centered hand-drawn eye pair; auxiliary marks only when specified; large blank paper margins

color_randomization.method: golden-angle hue spacing with seeded single-hue saturation and lightness variation

color_treatment: one opaque flat color beside each pupil; no gradient or shaded rendering
creative_direction: Make broad eye loops from fine pen contours, leaving the lower outer portion of each loop open. Both large black pupils look left, carrying broad tilted comma-shaped paper reserves. One upper curve may flatten briefly while the other continues its arch. Keep iris accents flat and small. Add two short brows whose outside ends lift just a little, without dramatic arches. The incomplete loops should feel deliberate, not damaged. Keep the eyes similar in scale on spacious paper. There is no mouth.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
